en: A black-and-white image depicting a European town square with historic buildings. Prominent in the center is a tall clock tower with an ornate spire and a weather vane on top. The buildings have traditional German architecture, and there's signage on the facade of one reading 'Betten... Daunen.' On the right, an ornate building labeled 'Rathaus' (town hall) is visible. At the bottom right of the postcard, the text 'Frankenberg i./Sa. Markt' is clearly printed.
